title: euphorbia officinarum subsp. echinus
intro: Euphorbia officinarum subsp. echinus, commonly known as the African spurge, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-allergic, and antiseptic effects, which can aid in pain relief, reducing allergic reactions, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Euphorbia officinarum subsp. echinus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
